test_idefics3_image_understanding: run the pytest integration test that sends an image URL to the Idefics3-8B-Llama3 model and validates the generated text response
test_idefics3_fixture_health: run the flash_idefics3_next fixture that launches the HuggingFaceM4/Idefics3-8B-Llama3 model and waits for health check
test_idefics3_generate_with_url: run the async generate call on the Idefics3 client with an image URL and a text query to get a description
test_idefics3_response_snapshot: run the Idefics3 test and compare the full response object against a stored snapshot for regression detection
test_idefics3_token_count: run the Idefics3 test and assert that the number of generated tokens matches the expected count
